cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I told the committee I couldn't chair another year. Please appreciate what those two sentences took.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good. Could you stay on until we find someone?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I rehearsed in your car until I stopped apologising. That wasn't me advertising a temporary vacancy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll tell them you're exhausted and need a break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't supply the excuse I spent an hour removing. Could you recognise a refusal I finally managed without one?
